Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: add Prisma migrations and production deployment support

- Pin Prisma CLI and Client to exact version 6.19.3 for compatibility
- Move Prisma CLI from devDependencies to dependencies for production use
- Create initial database migration \(20241025000000_init\)
- Update Dockerfile to copy Prisma schema, migrations, and CLI to production
- Add docker-entrypoint.sh to run migrations before app startup
- Make seed script safe to rerun without overwriting existing passwords

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: resolve Server Action mismatch and CredentialsSignin errors

Root causes:
- Login form used inline anonymous server action with unstable action ID
- Auth.js errors were not caught, causing HTTP 500 on invalid credentials
- Missing trustHost configuration for reverse proxy deployments

Changes:
- Extract login action to named export for stable action IDs
- Add proper error handling that preserves Auth.js redirect exceptions  
- Display user-friendly error messages for invalid credentials
- Add trustHost: true for Coolify/reverse proxy compatibility
- Add JWT/session callbacks to include user ID in session
- Add error styling to globals.css

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
